name: httpserve_start
description: Start the HTTP server. Three arguments: host (e.g. `'localhost'` or `'0.0.0.0'`), port, and auth string. Auth empty disables auth; `'user:pass'` enables Basic-auth; any other value is treated as an X-API-Key. Returns a startup confirmation string.

name: httpserve_stop
description: Stop the HTTP server thread. Pair with `httpserve_start` for graceful shutdown.
